sentences.text: The herd has not returned, and a convincing story will not feed the camp.
sentences.approvedCue: Hold the hungry camp beside an empty route where the expected herd should have appeared.

sentences.text: Beyond the Last Stone begins with a prehistoric community facing hunger and an uncertain route forward.
sentences.approvedCue: Introduce Ar and the River People around the small remaining food supply.

sentences.text: Ar, a young hunter, asks what people have actually seen; others remember what stories can carry.
sentences.approvedCue: Let Ar point to an observed track while Karr holds attention with remembered words.

sentences.text: They must decide together before anyone can be sure which signs to trust.
sentences.approvedCue: Keep the possible routes open while the group recognizes it must move before knowing enough.

sentences.text: Through tracks, counting stones, and fireside arguments, the novel makes early ideas about knowledge feel immediate.
sentences.approvedCue: Show counting stones, tracks and a fireside exchange in quick connected cuts.

sentences.text: Its people need knowledge, but they also need courage, shared memory, and one another.
sentences.approvedCue: Let Kee and the others bring memory and food into the same conversation.

sentences.text: The adventure is discovering how an idea can guide a life without becoming a certainty.
sentences.approvedCue: Keep a useful route mark beside an uncertainty mark rather than a guarantee.

sentences.text: Join the River People at the first hungry camp, where every claim has somewhere to lead.
sentences.approvedCue: End at the first camp with the people preparing to decide, without revealing which route succeeds.

The centre is a labelled inventory row (food, six stones, fire, roots, seeds) plus two text cards. This is the floating labelled-clipart pattern ART_DIRECTION rejects, with no visible exchange.

defects.what: The 'remembered herd' is drawn as three solid, realistic grazing bison standing on the horizon (top right), with no memory/story treatment and no link to Karr, and it stays on screen through 'They must decide together...' and the scene end. A viewer reads that the herd is present, contradicting scene 1 ('The herd has not returned') and the book's premise.
defects.fix: Render it as a clearly remembered/storied image (ochre cave-painting outline or story-smoke rising from Karr's gesture, reduced opacity, off the ground line) and fade it out before sentence 2; or remove it.

defects.what: Karr (scale .7) stands directly behind the hearth with the flames covering his legs and feet; the scene has no ground plane or horizon to establish depth, so he reads as standing in or floating above the fire. Silhouette/prop overlap on the scene's central figure.
defects.fix: Put Karr beside the hearth on the shared baseline (or add a ground band and place him clearly behind it with feet visible above the flames), keeping the fire between Karr and Kee without overlapping either body.

defects.sentence: 2 'Join the River People at the first hungry camp...' and last frame
defects.what: The closing invitation ends with Ar, the protagonist, showing a downturned frowning mouth and Karr worried (1:08 and 1:13), so the final reading invitation lands on a dejected beat. The performance plan says 'Ar turns back to the camp, curious'. Verified on 3x crops (qa/independent-r1/ar-s4s2.png, ar-s4last.png): Ar's mouth is clearly downturned.
defects.fix: Give Ar a curious/hopeful expression held through the scene end (character.express curious with no decay to sad); keep Karr's concern as the contrasting note.

defects.sentence: 1 'The herd has not returned, and a convincing story will not feed the camp.'
defects.what: Opening shot of a 'restrained urgency' scene: Ar smiles with a level gaze toward the group (plan: 'Ar skeptical, gaze on the empty pass'), and Kee looks forward rather than at the food (plan: 'eyes on the food'). The hungry-camp stakes are not carried by the protagonist's face (crop qa/independent-r1/s1s1-faces.png).
defects.fix: Ar: character.express skeptical and lookAt the pass/path on the right; Kee: lookAt the food hide.

defects.sentence: 2 'They must decide together before anyone can be sure which signs to trust.' and last frame
defects.what: Taan smiles contentedly while the narration stresses uncertainty; the plan requires 'Taan skeptical'. With Ar and Karr worried, the smile reads as an off-cue expression.
defects.fix: Set Taan skeptical (raised brow, flat mouth) and turn his gaze to the fork.

defects.what: The far path is a lone tan wedge that starts on the ground beside Ar and narrows into the mountain gap without connecting to the camp, and a small stray mountain fragment (between the path and the book, ~x 750-780) is wedged against the book edge; reads as a leaning plank plus a leftover shape.

defects.what: Unlike scenes 1, 2 and 4, scene 3 has no horizon or ground at all; the upper ~45% of the stage is empty and the cast floats on a void, which also causes the Karr depth problem above.
defects.fix: Add the same flat ridge/ground band used elsewhere (no frames) to anchor the camp.

defects.what: The black rock in the river is a near-black half-disc; in Night it is almost indistinguishable from the background where it meets the bank, and in all themes it reads more as a hole than a rock. Confirmed on the Night contact sheet: the rock nearly vanishes.
defects.fix: Use a dark-grey stone colour with a lighter Night token and a rock-like silhouette.
